_about: Public-domain Isaac Backus (1724-1806), Baptist pastor at Middleborough and champion of religious liberty, for the Word Hoard: A History of New-England with particular reference to the Baptists (Boston, 1777; Providence, 1784; Boston, 1796), David Weston's second edition (Newton: Backus Historical Society, 1871, two volumes), the Abridgment (1804) and An Appeal to the Public for Religious Liberty (1773), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 39 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

backus-history-1-1777: A History of New-England, with particular Reference to the Baptists, vol. I (Boston: Edward Draper; 1777)
backus-history-2-1784: A Church History of New-England, vol. II, from 1690 to 1784 (Providence: John Carter, 1784)
backus-history-3-1796: A Church History of New-England, vol. III, from 1783 to 1796 (Boston: Manning & Loring, 1796)
backus-history-weston-1: A History of New England with particular Reference to the Baptists, vol. I, ed. David Weston (Newton, Mass.: Backus Historical Society, 1871)
backus-history-weston-2: A History of New England with particular Reference to the Baptists, vol. II, ed. David Weston (Newton, Mass.: Backus Historical Society, 1871)
backus-abridgment-1804: An Abridgment of the Church History of New-England, from 1602 to 1804 (Boston: E. Lincoln for the author, 1804)
backus-appeal-1773: An Appeal to the Public for Religious Liberty (Boston: John Boyle, MDCCLXXIII)
